tasks.label: Build Mouse Highlighter
args: C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\windres.exe resources.rc -o resources.o && C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\gcc.exe -fdiagnostics-color=always -O2 -s Mouse_Highlighter.c resources.o -o "${workspaceFolder}\MouseHighlighter.exe" -lgdi32 -luser32 -mwindows -ldwmapi -lcomdlg32 -lcomctl32 -municode -ladvapi32 -lshell32 -lwinmm
